Heart of the Forest

Internal ID: TrinketBronzeHealth | Type: Trinkets | Source: Forge | Crafting Materials: Bronze x5, Ancient seed x5, Greydwarf Shaman trophy x1 | Adrenaline Cost: 50 | Effect: +25% health regen | Duration: 1m

Introduction. Heart of the Forest is a Black Forest-tier trinket, and one of the first available in the game.

Effects. Once 50 Adrenaline has been gained, the Heart of the Forest will trigger automatically, providing +25% health regeneration for 60 seconds.
